# Eisenhower Presidential Library

> > Official presidential library and museum in Abilene, Kansas, preserving the legacy of Dwight D. Eisenhower's military and presidential career through archives, exhibits, and educational programs.

The Eisenhower Presidential Library, administered by the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA), houses declassified documents on Cold War aerial intelligence, U-2 reconnaissance, and foreign policy, alongside photograph collections, educational resources, and public programs exploring Eisenhower's World War II leadership and presidency.

## Key Topics

- Dwight D. Eisenhower
- Cold War
- U-2 reconnaissance
- Aerial intelligence

- World War II

- Abilene, Kansas
- NARA

## Research & Archives

- [Photographs](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/research/photographs): Archival photograph collections from Eisenhower's military and presidency
- [Aerial Intelligence During the Cold War](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/research/online-documents/aerial-intelligence-during-cold-war): Declassified documents on U-2 reconnaissance and Cold War surveillance
- [EISENHOWER, MAMIE DOUD](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/research/finding-aids/eisenhower-mamie-doud): Finding aid for Mamie Doud Eisenhower's archival papers and correspondence
- [Declassified Documents - Fiscal Year 2016](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/research/online-documents/declassified-documents-fiscal-year-2016): FY2016 declassified NSC documents on foreign policy and atomic weapons
- [Foreign Language Guides](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/research/foreign-language-guides): Educational guides for foreign language research and field trips

## Exhibits & Museum

- [Drawn to Combat: Bill Mauldin & the Art of War](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/exhibits/drawn-combat-bill-mauldin-art-war): Exhibition featuring Bill Mauldin's WWII cartoons and Willie and Joe
- [Boyhood Home Now Open for Tours](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/press-releases/boyhood-home-now-open-tours): Announcement of Eisenhower's boyhood home reopening for public tours

## Educational Programs & Events

- [Operation Safe Haven: The Hungarian Refugee Crisis of 1956-1958 (Lunch & Learn)](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/press-releases/operation-safe-haven-hungarian-refugee-crisis-1956-1958-lunch-learn): Lunch & Learn event on Operation Safe Haven and 1956 Hungarian refugees
- [Calculated Risk - May Lunch & Learn](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/press-releases/calculated-risk-may-lunch-learn): Lunch & Learn on Cold War aerial intelligence and U-2 reconnaissance
- [Patton in Morocco Lunch & Learn](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/press-releases/patton-morocco-lunch-learn): Lunch & Learn on Patton's WWII Operation Torch leadership in Morocco
- [Ike's Virtual Book Club - The Right Stuff](https://www.eisenhowerlibrary.gov/press-releases/ikes-virtual-book-club-right-stuff): Virtual book club discussion of Tom Wolfe's The Right Stuff
